market_summary: USD strength continues across Gold, EUR, and GBP with heavy downside pressure below VWAP/EMA50 baselines. US100 exhibits strong bullish trend expansion above VAH and session highs during New York hours, presenting a high-confluence BUY opportunity, while BTCUSD consolidates below session highs with mild delta divergence.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4029.76) and below POC (4044.16). CVD is -2.40 (BEARISH) matching the intense sell-off. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4037.35) and EMA50 (4029.89). Price is hugging the lower -2 ATR band (4001.80) with extreme momentum, breaking the Session Low at 3998.22. However, the forming bar is extended at the extreme low without a pullback, and RVOL has diminished (0.635) after the initial breakdown spike. Prefer HOLD for a pullback retest rather than chasing at the extreme.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10824 to VAH 1.11472) and near POC (1.10920). CVD is -14,644 (BEARISH) though showing a mild upward slope (+2627.46). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.11270) and EMA50 (1.11214). Price is hovering slightly above lower -2 ATR band (1.10890) and testing Session Low (1.10824). RVOL is average (0.948). Being stuck near POC inside the Value Area warrants waiting for a clear breakdown or reclaim.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32661 to VAH 1.33251) and below POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-2,358). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (1.33077) and EMA50 (1.33043). ATR is contracting mid-channel near the lower ATR band. RVOL is weak at 0.29. Lacks volume and delta expansion to justify an entry.

Price is cleanly above VAH (28337.86) and above POC (28264.82). CVD is +13.08 (BULLISH) with positive slope. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is strongly above VWAP (28180.35) and EMA50 (28255.85). ATR channel is expanding past upper band (28512.36) hitting fresh Session Highs (28565.11). While index CFD tick RVOL is 0.859 (noting US100 tick volume caveat), the structural breakout above EMA20/50 and VAH during NY session is clean. Pullback entry near live price.
signals.level_event: acceptance above VAH and Session High breakout

lucid_plan.sizing: fixed target 5 cannot reach $381 net at an allowed size; next structure Session High at 25.5 gives $506 net with 1 NQ (risk $335)

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (73998.28) and above POC (73660.42). CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.06), showing divergence against the upward move. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73749.12) and EMA50 (73850.44). Price touched upper +2 ATR band (74606.88) and rejected near Session High (74706.20) with high upper wicks. RVOL is 1.092 without yellow volume confirmation. The bearish CVD divergence at upper ATR/Session High resistance suggests HOLD.
